notes.title: Free Remake Update!
notes.notes:
Free Remake Update! The remastered version of "Rich Party" is officially launched!
After nine months of remake, we are pleased to announce the launch of the remastered version of "Rich Party"! Thank you all for your support!
For players who have already purchased "Rich Party", it can be updated for free without the need to purchase again! After the game is remade, it will bring new substantive content, including new skins, new vehicles, the gameplay of the initial creative workshop (specifically Steam Workshop), achievement system, task system, and so on. After the update of the Creative Workshop, players can freely combine the components we have prepared, create new maps, and design new gameplay. The remastered version will also comprehensively optimize game performance, voice over optimization, and add exclusive BGM to each image. A brand new theme song will also be launched. Our sincerity is full, all for improving the player experience.
The remastered version will be discounted by 20% in the first week of launch! You can pay more attention to our social media, and there will be more activities continuously updated on social media platforms in the future!
Thank you all for your support and love! If you have any questions, you can join the official community for feedback or leave a message on social media!

notes.title: The remastered version of the Rich Party
notes.notes:
Dear players, wait a long time!
The remastered version of the Rich Party is about to undergo a major update on the Steam platform!
Since the launch of "Rich Party", we have felt everyone's abundant gaming enthusiasm. Thank you for your love and support of "Rich Party"! At the same time, we deeply realize that there are still many significant issues with the game itself, which have affected the gaming experience of all players. The game did not perform as expected and disappointed some of the players who supported us. In order to live up to the support of players, optimize everyone's experience, and create better game performance, the production team has decided to remake the game.
For players who have already purchased "Rich Party", they can update the game directly on Steam without having to purchase again. After the game is remade, it will bring new substantive content, including new skins, new vehicles, the gameplay of the initial creative workshop (specifically Steam Workshop), achievement system, task system, and so on. After the update of the Creative Workshop, players can freely combine the components we have prepared, create new maps, and design new gameplay. The remastered version will also comprehensively optimize game performance, voice over optimization, and add exclusive BGM to each image. A brand new theme song will also be launched. Our sincerity is full, all for improving the player experience.
We thank all players for their attention and understanding of Rich Party, and welcome them to continue providing valuable feedback and suggestions to work together with us to create a better gaming experience. Welcome everyone to leave comments on Steam or join the official community to provide feedback and suggestions. Please also pay more attention to our social media. There will be more activities continuously updated on social media platforms in the future.
